name: Big Eater Contest
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Tap toilet door to make him go for a break.
Tap money sign to increase bonus reward.
Drag lemon water to help digestion.
Tap water dispenser to drink water.
Drag burger to dog so it can eat.
Drag burger to judge so he eats.
Drag kid onto shoulders for squats exercise.
Tap phone filter to make burgers look tasty.
Tap or swipe belt to loosen it and finish level.
